note: Curated suggestion catalog shown on the Games tab before any search. searchQuery is used against the SteamUnlocked source; steamQuery/steamYear (optional) let the backend enrich the card with official Steam metadata. Descriptions are original fallbacks used when Steam metadata is unavailable.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
games.description: A story-driven open-world crime saga set in a neon-soaked 1980s city, following a mob enforcer's climb from street errands to owning the town — drive, roam and cause mayhem on your own terms.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories
games.description: A gritty GTA chapter set in the 1990s version of Liberty City, where a loyal soldier works through the city's warring families — compact missions with the same sandbox freedom.

games.title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)
games.description: The beloved street racer where you climb a blacklist of rivals while being hunted by police — gritty city circuits, heavy car culture and constant pursuit tension.

games.title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2012)
games.description: Criterion's open-city racer: grab any car you spot, chase speed cameras and jackpots, and outdrive rivals in fast dropped-in challenges across a shared world.

games.title: Max Payne
games.description: A noir revenge thriller built on bullet-time gunplay, graphic-novel cutscenes and a conspiracy trail through snowy New York — slow-motion shootouts that defined an era.

games.title: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne
games.description: The darker, leaner sequel: Max wears the badge again and falls into a forbidden romance while clearing house with improved physics, ragdolls and sharper bullet-time.

games.title: Project I.G.I. (IGI 1)
games.description: A mission-based tactical shooter with wide outdoor maps, scarce ammo and no mid-mission saves — plan routes, snipe guards and infiltrate heavily guarded bases.

games.title: IGI 2: Covert Strike
games.description: The sequel sharpens the formula with a bigger weapon locker, stealth-first objectives and tougher AI across infiltration missions that punish going loud.

games.title: FIFA 08
games.description: A late-2000s football sim with league licensing, skill drills and a deep career mode — a nostalgic pick for classic squads and low-spec machines.

games.title: FIFA 10
games.description: A refined kickabout with tighter defending, fluid 360-degree player movement and crisp presentation — remembered as one of the best-playing FIFAs of its generation.

games.title: Age of Empires
games.description: The founding classic of real-time strategy: gather resources, advance through the ages from stone to iron, and crush rivals with history's armies.

games.title: Age of Empires II
games.steamQuery: Age of Empires II Definitive Edition
games.description: The definitive medieval RTS: grow a civilization from the Dark Age to the Imperial Age, besiege castles and command landmark campaigns across history.

games.title: Age of Empires III
games.steamQuery: Age of Empires III Definitive Edition
games.description: Colonial-era strategy with home-city shipments, explorer heroes and treasure hunts — the most cinematic entry of the classic trilogy.

games.title: Call of Duty (2003)
games.description: The WWII squad-based shooter that made scripted infantry battles feel cinematic — fight through the Eastern Front, North Africa and Europe beside your unit.

games.title: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare
games.description: The genre-resetting modern shooter: a cinematic campaign, prestige progression and the multiplayer that turned cross-platform FPS into a mainstream obsession.

games.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009)
games.description: The bombastic sequel with new specialists, killstreaks and Spec Ops co-op missions wrapped around a globe-trotting campaign — a high point of the classic era.

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops
games.description: Cold War paranoia as an arcade FPS: black-ops missions across Cuba, Vietnam and the Arctic, plus the zombie mode — the series at its most theatrical.

games.title: Hitman: Codename 47
games.description: The original sandbox-assassin prototype: one clone, many targets and a toybox of disguises, fiber wire and improvised kills across globe-trotting contracts.

games.title: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin
games.description: 47 comes out of retirement only to be dragged back in: bigger sandboxes, a full arsenal of disguises and the series' signature rule — never be seen.

games.title: Hitman: Contracts
games.description: A darker trip through 47's past: reimagined hits from the first game alongside fresh contracts, with moodier levels and the signature disguise-and-strike gameplay.

games.title: Hitman: Blood Money
games.description: Widely called the peak of classic Hitman: newspaper-cutscene consequences, freeform murder mysteries and 'accident' kills that reward careful planning.

games.title: Hitman: Absolution
games.description: A chapter-driven take on the formula with instinct-assisted stealth, close-call disguises and Hollywood-style setpieces wrapping47's most personal story.

games.title: HITMAN (2016)
games.description: The start of the World of Assassination trilogy: enormous playground levels like Paris and Sapienza, dozens of systemic kill methods and replayable contracts.

games.title: Assassin's Creed
games.description: The first leap of faith: climb medieval cities as Altair, run rooftop assassinations and uncover a centuries-spanning war between Assassins and Templars.

games.title: Assassin's Creed II
games.description: Ezio's Renaissance debut: villa upgrades, family revenge and sunlit Italian cities that remain the series' most beloved playground.

games.title: Assassin's Creed III
games.description: The American Revolution with tree-climbing, frontier wilderness and naval skirmishes — a bolder sandbox that closed the Desmond saga.

games.title: Far Cry
games.description: Island-jungle FPS: mercs, vehicles and mutated horrors across wide tropical maps powered by the original CryEngine.

games.title: Far Cry 2
games.description: A brutal Africa-set sandbox with malaria, jamming weapons, spreading wildfire and missions you can approach from any angle — realism before convenience.

games.title: Far Cry 3
games.description: The open-world breakout: hunt and craft, tag enemies from a treetop perch and raid pirate camps on a tropical archipelago — the template modern Far Cry still follows.

games.title: Total Overdose: A Tacos of Action
games.description: An over-the-top action shooter: chain combo style rampages, bullet-time ricochets and luchador chaos across sun-baked sandbox levels.

games.title: Freedom Fighters
games.description: Soviet-occupied New York seen through a plumber turned resistance leader — recruit insurgents and order squad strikes in a cult classic of strategic shootouts.

games.title: Tomb Raider (2013)
games.description: Lara's origin reboot: shipwrecked on a hostile island, she learns to hunt, climb and fight — cinematic survival action with bow-first combat.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Anniversary
games.description: A remake of the 1996 classic: revisit Croft Manor and the original tombs with modernized platforming and puzzle solving.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Underworld
games.description: Myth-hunting across Thailand, Mexico and the Arctic — the classic trilogy's final entry with the biggest environmental puzzles.

games.title: Postal 2
games.description: A satirical week in the life where a mundane errand run can escalate into chaos — optional violence, dark humor and absolute player freedom.

games.title: Dead Space
games.description: Zero-g survival horror aboard a stripped-down space colony: dismember enemies with the plasma cutter, ration ammo and keep the lights low.

games.title: Dead Space 2
games.description: Faster and scarier: Isaac escapes a psychosis-plagued station with smoother movement, zero-g boosts and relentless Necromorph pressure.

games.title: Dead Space 3
games.description: Two-player survival on an ice planet: over-the-shoulder shooting, weapon crafting benches and the cosmic origin story of the Marker saga.

games.title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein
games.description: BJ's paranormal WWII raid: storm Nazi strongholds, shut down occult experiments and enjoy one of the finest linear shooter campaigns of its era.

games.title: Wolfenstein (2009)
games.description: The Raven Software middle chapter: dual-wield weapons and wield Veil powers through portal puzzles — a bridge between RTCW and the modern reboot.

games.title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell
games.description: Third Echelon infiltration with the iconic tri-goggles: shadows, sound discipline and precise takedowns in a Cold War-flavored campaign.

games.title: Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory
games.steamQuery: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Chaos Theory
games.description: The series' fan favorite: knife-the-camera stealth, dynamic lighting and a Japan-set story where weather and playstyle both reshape the mission.

games.title: Splinter Cell: Blacklist
games.description: Sam Fisher leads the Fifth Estate against escalating terror ultimatums — gadget-heavy missions played ghost, panther or assault.
